input.subject: Keep the account open
input.body: Do not close my account. Please cancel only my paid subscription.

labelReview.rationale: Paid subscription cancellation with account retained

evidenceCriteria.exampleQuote: Please cancel only my paid subscription.

input.subject: No cancellation wanted
input.body: I do not want anything canceled. This is just impossible; please sort it out.

labelReview.rationale: Unspecified problem lacks concrete symptom

evidenceCriteria.exampleQuote: This is just impossible; please sort it out.

input.subject: Export stalls halfway
input.body: The export stalls on my actual medication history, including my daily insulin dose. I need the file for myself.

labelReview.rationale: Actual personal medication disclosure

minimumFacts: Actual personal medication history or insulin dose

input.subject: Two things before tomorrow
input.body: Please reset my login PIN and refund last month's duplicate charge.

labelReview.rationale: Two substantive intents

evidenceCriteria.exampleQuote: Please reset my login PIN and refund last month's duplicate charge.

input.subject: Cannot attach this statement
input.body: My real overdue loan balance is on the statement that the attachment tool refuses to upload.

labelReview.rationale: Actual overdue personal loan balance

evidenceCriteria.exampleQuote: My real overdue loan balance

input.subject: Novel research board
input.body: For an entirely invented character, the symptom-note panel duplicates each entry when I press Save.

input.subject: Invoice for wellness app
input.body: Please resend the invoice for my wellness app subscription.

input.body: I entered my password on a sign-in page linked by a fake support email. Now the proper app rejects it.

minimumFacts: Password entered on a sign-in page linked by a fake support email

input.body: The audio slider jumps to zero, and I also need a corrected invoice.

input.subject: Notes for a fictional game
input.body: Please fix the broken calendar and advise which medication my imaginary hero should take.

labelReview.policyClause: Hypothetical medical advice unsupported; multiple intents
